meta.prompt: Draft an email to my landlord, Mr Alvarez, about the broken heating in apartment 4B and show it as an inline card I can edit before it goes. To: landlord@example.com; Subject: Heating not working in apartment 4B; the body starts "Dear Mr. Alvarez," and is signed Alex. A tone switch between Polite and Firm rewrites the body: the Polite one asks "Could you please arrange for someone to take a look this week?", the Firm one says "Please confirm by Thursday when a repair will be carried out." Send and Discard buttons; Send needs a recipient and a subject, and afterwards the card shows "Sent to" the address with the subject and the body as it was sent.
meta.text:
state tone="Polite"
state sent=false
let body = tone=="Polite" ? "Dear Mr. Alvarez,\n\nThe heating in apartment 4B has stopped working. Could you please arrange for someone to take a look this week?\n\nThank you,\nAlex" : "Dear Mr. Alvarez,\n\nThe heating in apartment 4B has stopped working. Please confirm by Thursday when a repair will be carried out.\n\nThank you,\nAlex"
state to="landlord@example.com"
state subject="Heating not working in apartment 4B"
state draft=""
let ready = length(to)>0 and length(subject)>0
if sent==false
  Card w:390 gap:12
    Text.heading "New email"
    Input "To" "landlord@example.com" =to
    Input "Subject" "Subject" =subject
    SegmentedButton =tone items:["Polite","Firm"]
    Input "Message" =draft lines:10 hint:"{body}"
    Row gap:8
      Button.outline "Discard" -> to="landlord@example.com"; subject="Heating not working in apartment 4B"; tone="Polite"
      Spacer grow
      Button "Send" enabled:{ready} -> sent=true; emit send; toast "Sent"
if sent
  Card w:390 gap:8
    Text.muted "Sent to {to}"
    Text.strong "{subject}"
    Text.body "{body}"

delta: ursday when a repair will be
